comparison.objective: Aim a rover solar panel at a lamp using a shadow sight; candidate tunes impact absorption.
comparison.physical_skill: Panel articulation guided by visual shadow feedback versus bimanual tool insertion, fine collar rotation and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Panel points at the lamp versus two safe carriage stops without bottoming, rebound or drift.
comparison.reason: Both use iterative observation, but they test different mechanisms and outcomes. No detailed aiming tolerance or spec is available.
